title: Chore: (Docs) Adds the how to create a reproduction docs
body:
With this pull request, the documentation is expanded to include instructions on how to create a working reproduction to help triage and solve issues quicker.

What was done:
- Added a new page `how-to-reproduce`.
- Updated the toc file
- Added images.

Feel free to provide feedback
